listings.H01:
Arithmetic:
    int: value
    return: int
    twice:
        return: value * 2
    plusOne:
        return: value + 1

ApplyProbe:
    return: int
    run:
        @: chosen Arithmetic\twice
        int: first chosen(7)
        chosen := Arithmetic\plusOne
        int: second chosen(7)
        return: first * 100 + second
listings.H02:
PairOperation :: (int: a; int: b; return: int)

Candidate:
    int: b
    int: a
    return: int
    encode:
        return: b * 10 + a

SignatureProbe:
    return: int
    run:
        @: selected PairOperation Candidate\encode
        int: throughSignature selected(a := 2; b := 7)
        int: directly Candidate\encode(a := 2; b := 7)
        return: throughSignature * 100 + directly
listings.H03:
Addition:
    int: first
    int: second
    return: int
    add:
        return: first + second

ClosureProbe:
    return: int
    run:
        throws:
            FxArity
            FxIndex
            FxRecordArity
            FxTypeToken
            FxKernelFailure
        @: add5 partial(Addition\add; (5))
        @: add100 partial(Addition\add; (100))
        int: saved 1000
        int: first add5(1)
        int: second add100(1)
        int: again add5(1)
        return: first * 1000000 + second * 1000 + again
listings.H04:
Addition:
    int: x
    int: y
    return: int
    add:
        return: x + y

DefaultProbe:
    return: int
    run:
        int: y 100
        @: fiveContext (merge(Addition; (int: y 5)))
        @: add5 fiveContext\add
        int: first add5(1)
        int: explicit add5(1; y := 25)
        int: zero add5(1; y := 0)
        int: again add5(1)
        return: first * 1000000 + explicit * 10000 + zero * 100 + again
listings.H06:
Functions:
    int: x
    return: int
    twice:
        return: x * 2
    next:
        return: x + 1

CompositionProbe:
    return: int
    run:
        int: a Functions\next(Functions\twice(4))
        int: b Functions\twice(Functions\next(4))
        return: a * 100 + b
listings.H07:
PreparedOps:
    @: left int
    []: @(int) right
    const: int: PASS_ARGS_AS_IS 0
    const: int: PRIORITY sys\priority("+")
    return: int
    twice:
        return: \left + \left

RawOps:
    @: left
    []: @ right
    const: int: PASS_ARGS_AS_IS 1
    const: int: PRIORITY sys\priority("+")
    return: int
    twice:
        int: first sys\eval(left)
        int: second sys\eval(left)
        return: first + second

Meter:
    int: calls 0
    return: int
    next:
        node\calls += 1
        return: node\calls

Evaluation:
    return: int
    prepared:
        return: (Meter\next() PreparedOps\twice 0)
    raw:
        return: (Meter\next() RawOps\twice 0)
